Type: six-drawer double dresser
Use: storing clothes; bedroom
Style: contemporary, classic, modern
Materials: cherry veneer with flame grain, dark lacquered finish, slim metal pulls
Colors: dark reddish espresso brown, silver
Shape: wide low case, gently bowed drawer fronts, slatted open sides, slender tapered legs, recessed bar pulls, long and elegant
Feel: rich, polished, refined
Goes with: cream bedding, warm neutral walls, chrome accents; contemporary or transitional bedrooms

product.name: Pinzon Walthum Dresser
product.description: Beautiful dresser has 6 drawers with French dovetail fronts and English backs on double wood glides Solid rubberwood and ash veneer with dark Java finish; brushed aluminum handles 75-pound capacity; drawers are 27 inches long by 14-1/4 inches deep by 6-1/4 inches high Coordinates with the Pinzon Walthum Bedroom Furniture Collection Measures 33-1/4 inches high by 64 inches wide by 20 inches deep
